overview_description.description:
LemonBox combines big data and US registered dietitians, to offer personal, nutritional, and living-well advice to Chinese customers. It provides personalized daily vitamin packs made in the U.S. and shipped to customers within 7-10 days, based on a monthly subscription model.

LemonBox was founded in 2016 and is based in Beijing, China.
